recognize_zh: 抹片中一片淡藍色細胞質連成的大型聚集，內含多顆偏小、形狀不規則的細胞核，符合成群的高雪細胞（Gaucher cells）；但本圖解析度有限，典型的「皺摺薄紙樣」細胞質紋路不甚清楚。
features: Large aggregate of cells with abundant pale blue cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Multiple small, eccentric, irregular to crushed nuclei within the aggregate
Cytoplasm appears finely textured; the characteristic striated 'crumpled tissue paper' pattern is not well resolved
Scattered clear vacuoles and linear stretched strands in the background
describe_en: Smear (probably bone marrow aspirate) shows a large aggregate of cells with abundant pale blue cytoplasm and indistinct borders, containing numerous small, eccentric, irregular nuclei, with scattered vacuoles and stretched crush artifact. The distinctive fibrillary, crumpled tissue paper texture of Gaucher cell cytoplasm is not clearly resolved at this resolution, so the morphology alone is only suggestive. In the proper clinical context the findings are consistent with clusters of Gaucher cells; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay or GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphologically indistinguishable; normal glucocerebrosidase activity and the underlying disease separate them.
Niemann-Pick cells have bubbly, vacuolated foamy cytoplasm rather than striated fibrillary cytoplasm.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue-green granules rather than diffuse pale striated cytoplasm.
Tumor clusters show nuclear pleomorphism, nucleoli and molding rather than small bland eccentric nuclei in abundant cytoplasm.
